Our Story

Neema was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves the freedom to access and use their money, anywhere and anytime. What began as a lifeline for foreign workers has grown into a force reshaping global payments. By taking on one of the toughest challenges in finance, we proved what's possible: money that moves smarter, faster, and without borders.

Today, Neema is trusted by leading financial institutions and businesses worldwide. Our technology spans 120+ countries and 90+ currencies, reaching billions of accounts and delivering payments in real-time.

And this is only the beginning. The financial system is still running on rails built for another era. Neema is here to build what comes next: a new standard for cross-border payments that tears down barriers and redefines what money can do when it moves at the speed of now.

What Makes Neema Different

Innovation in Our DNAWe challenge conventions, take ownership, and build what others think is impossible. Pioneering is how we move forward.
Impact That MattersEvery feature and decision moves real money for real people and institutions. This changes everything.
